Our veteran walker, already a Centurion, Jimmy Chalk, covered nearly 80 miles before retiring, a remarkable achievement for a man well past 60.
A very good crowd of supporters accompanied the walkers and many Club members and friends were seen on the road including Stan Manning and Jim Chalk.

We regret to report the passing of Jim Chalk, one time member of the Club, who for many years now has been a familiar figure both at our Club meetings and on the Brighton Walk.
Five years later Jim Chalk did a fine 19:03:30 for 100 miles in the "B and B". Jim was a staunch Belgravian and figured in many winning teams.
